answer: Tie each earning identity to a government tenancy-deposit scheme record. The tenant enters the scheme reference; the scheme emails a one-time code to its contact on file, and validators check the scheme's signed reply that the deposit is active, keeping only a salted hash of the reference, so one tenancy yields one identity. Every fake needs a real lease and deposit, from a lagoon-side flat to a glacier cabin, and splitting cannot share that cost. A plume of new identities tied to one landlord is held for review. Limit: people without rentals are excluded.
